info.corpo: 2,678 points. Top 40 out of 166 albums nominated by bloggers, radio hosts and journalists of the heavy underground.
Roadburn Chronicles debuts at #14 in the August 2026 Doom Charts, published September 4.
Roadburn Chronicles, out August 28, 2026 on Octopus Rising / Argonauta Records.
The extended groove of stoner rock. The crushing weight of classic doom. High-voltage fuzz, hypnotic tempos.
Toxic Basement Studio, Carate Brianza, with Carlo Altobelli. November 2024 to January 2025: tubes, drum room, valve saturation.
Roadburn Chronicles is a journey through the human condition: between darkness and redemption, with room for freedom and moments of light.
Revenant has an official video on YouTube. Viper, as Inner-Strength Check puts it, is one of the darkest sides of the album.
A sub-label of Argonauta Records, the Italian home of stoner, doom, sludge and post metal. Distribution across Europe, the Americas and Japan.
01 S.U.R.E. / 02 The Sinner / 03 Turning Point / 04 I For An I / 05 Rusty Blues / 06 Viper / 07 Revenant / 08 Dreamer's Sunsets / 09 Monsters' Conceal / 10 An Old Van and a Couple of Beers

info.titolo: This is how weight is built.
info.corpo: Guitar with active pickups, Orange tube head, 5-string bass tuned low. British and vintage fuzz.
An old blue van crosses a psychedelic desert. The last track on the record is 'An Old Van and a Couple of Beers'.
A bench, a toast for Father's Day. A dirty, deep blues, as Radiocoop describes it.
Radiocoop also hears Motörhead-style speed metal (I For An I) and dirty, deep blues (Rusty Blues).
Italian, French, German, English: Radiocoop, Heavy Metal Webzine, W.T.R. Mag', Der Fuzzer, Outlaws Of The Sun, Pitstop Metal.

info.titolo: The name that keeps coming back: Kyuss.
info.corpo: Outlaws Of The Sun and Pitstop Metal cite it among the influences. In the Breathing The Core interview, Kyuss is among the reference points named by the band.
Cited by the press: Kyuss, Orange Goblin, Dozer, Monster Magnet, Fu Manchu. (Outlaws Of The Sun, Pitstop Metal)

info.titolo: The press puts them side by side.
info.corpo: Kyuss, Orange Goblin and Dozer according to Steve Howe of Outlaws Of The Sun. Monster Magnet and Fu Manchu are also cited by Pitstop Metal.
In the EPK's FFO: The Sword, Black Sabbath, Windhand, Down, Trouble.

band.corpo: Guitar and founder. Ex-Orphean (death metal), he started Petrosa in 2019.
Massive tube-driven riffs, pentatonic grooves, British and vintage fuzz. The architect of the Petrosa sound.
Drums. Milanese, raised on skate culture and squat-scene punk.
Dynamic control, dry snare, heavy ride and crash. The engine that drives the weight.
Vocals. Baritone with over twenty years of experience: from clean to distorted.
Bluesy grit, authoritative melody, cavernous doom timbre. The emotional heart of the band.
Bass. After Big Crunch, in Petrosa since 2024.
Thick, sinister tone, clean sub-lows, overdrive in the mids. It amplifies every riff.

band.titolo: Four musicians. One wall of sound.
band.corpo: Antonio Buonocore, guitar. Giorgio Monza, drums. Aldo Colciago, vocals. Andrea Vignati, bass. From Milan, Italy.
Founded by Antonio Buonocore. Now four strong: Antonio, Giorgio, Aldo and Andrea.
